title: Adobe Experience Manager is affected by a stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability that could be abused by a…
description: Adobe Experience Manager contains a stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows low-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields. When a victim visits a page with the vulnerable field, the injected JavaScript may execute in their browser. This vulnerability affects confidentiality and integrity but does not impact availability.
